text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Victoria Mile. I 
still hadn't been able to shake the shock 
of that day.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...The 'Crimson Wedge' is prone to 
becoming chronic.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Her next race is a blank slate... and even 
her daily training will likely be 
restricted.

The 'Crimson Wedge' that afflicted Red 
Desire and the others is, just as she 
said, prone to frequent recurrences.

"If the prognosis is poor, it can force a 
long-term hiatus... It is the reason why 
many Umamusume are forced to stop 
running."

I just finished running the Triple Tiara 
races and had barely set my sights on the 
new goal of racing overseas, and yet...

Even though so many fans are beginning to 
place high hopes on her running...—

I couldn't bear the thought of Red 
Desire's career ending right here.
choice_data_list:
More than anyone else, the one who wants 
to see her future is... me.

More than anyone else, the one who wants 
to see her future is... me.

text_block_list.text:
No matter how desperate the situation was, 
giving up was never an option.

The importance of believing in yourself to 
the end— and that as long as you don't 
give up, you can seize hope with your own 
two hands.

She taught me everything. —That is 
precisely why.

To save Red Desire, even if the odds are 
infinitesimally small—
choice_data_list: I will keep fighting tooth and nail!

text_block_list.text:
She devoured countless literature both 
domestic and international, searching 
desperately for any possibility to save 
Red Desire.
And then, I reached a single answer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Moving... to America...?

This chronic ailment plaguing Umamusume 
was difficult to cure, and treating it 
while continuing to race was considered 
almost impossible.
Here in Japan, that is.

America had a drug that could combat the 
'Crimson Wedge.' It's a preventive 
medicine against the 'Crimson Wedge' that 
cannot be used in Japan right now.

In other words... while difficult in 
Japan, going to America would open the 
possibility of racing through medication 
without the constant fear of a relapse.

Of course, it won't be that simple. In an 
unfamiliar environment, whether she can 
achieve such brilliant results as before 
is uncertain—

There was no guarantee I could remain by 
her side as her dedicated Trainer either.
—Even so.

No matter what, I absolutely didn't want 
Red Desire's forward march to be stopped.
choice_data_list:
Because you... you're more precious to me 
than anything else.

Because you... are more precious to me 
than anything else

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
............ I offer you my gratitude, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You worked so desperately to devise a 
plan to save me from the 'Crimson 
Wedge'..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply... profoundly moved. That 
sincerity alone is the greatest salvation 
to heal this body of mine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No, not yet.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The time has not yet come.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Once I decided to cross the ocean... I 
traced the footsteps of the Japanese 
Umamusume who had ventured abroad before 
me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —That is why I know.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even crossing the sea in top form... there 
have been many pioneers who were still 
unable to overcome the world's towering 
wall.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Just how brutal a trial it is to conquer 
the world and seize its glory... I 
understand it all too well."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Since I understand it so well, I'm sure 
you know it too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"With so many concerns looming like this, 
a brilliant campaign in America will be 
difficult, they say."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...It must have been a bitter decision 
for you as well."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I cross the sea now... and manage 
to balance treatment and trials as fate 
dictates, my soul will never be 
satisfied...—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "What I seek is not peace of mind."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To conquer adversity and burn your soul to 
ashes—beyond that lies true fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause, celebrating this very 
life.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"All those days we overcame trials 
together."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"All the brilliance we have seized 
together."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Every single glory I have won together 
with you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It drives me. Fiercely and powerfully 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Saintess Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to defy predetermined 
fate—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To shatter the ultimate trial of the 
'Crimson Wedge' with my own hands, in my 
own unique way!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because no matter when, no matter what, 
you believed in me, truly cared for me, 
and stayed by my side—...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have resolved to face the "Crimson 
Wedge" head-on.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I want to go to the world stage... and 
definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So until then... I will continue to take 
on trials here in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Enduring the trials of this land, the 
moment I became able to aim solely for 
victory—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With heads held high in pride, to venture 
out into the world.

In Red Desire, there was neither 
resignation nor despair. With strong 
determination, she declared that she would 
surpass the "Crimson Wedge" while 
continuing to win in domestic races.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...No, my one and only resonator.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If you are lost, then allow this Saint, 
Red Desire, to show you the way once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: We must not run away.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Not a reincarnation born of escapism, but 
a journey toward certain victory—a 
challenge to seize the supreme radiance—!

I thought it was reckless. And yet, that 
very recklessness... was the image of the 
Saint I had yearned for all along.
—Only a single answer remained.
choice_data_list:
Got it. I'll be with you till the very 
end.

Got it. I'll be with you until the very 
end.

text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I need to decide 
on our next goal. It would be wise to take 
a look at the situation whenever we find a 
gap during the summer training camp.
choice_data_list:
How about the Sapporo Kinen for your next 
race?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ――...Heh, hehe... Uhehehe!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes, of course! Let us proceed 
along the path you have envisioned!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You and I, our hearts are always as 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"You are truly the one worthy of sharing 
my destiny. Please... remain by my side 
from this moment forth."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>...!

The thorny path we chose together. Yet 
beyond it surely lies an "Otherworld" 
beyond anyone's wildest imagination.
